meta.name: vercel-composition-patterns
meta.description: React composition patterns that scale. Use when refactoring components with boolean prop proliferation, building flexible component libraries, or designing reusable APIs. Triggers on tasks involving compound components, render props, context providers, or component architecture. Includes React 19 API changes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 Vercel 的 React 组合模式回应:对带很多布尔开关的组件,建议用复合组件、状态提升等组合写法,并给出正确/错误代码示例;涉及 React 19 会区分新 API 用法。
howto.when: 重构布尔属性多的组件、搭建组件库、设计可复用组件 API 等,或涉及复合组件、渲染属性、Context 等任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我重构这个组件,去掉那些布尔 props,改用组合模式。
say.note: 会给出重构建议和示例代码。

say.text: 这个组件用 render props,怎么改成 children 组合?
say.note: 会按实现模式规则给改法。

say.text: 项目要升 React 19,检查哪些 forwardRef 要改。
say.note: 会触发 React 19 规则提醒。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude follows Vercel's React composition patterns: for components with many boolean props, it suggests composition via compound components and state lifting, and provides correct/incorrect code examples. It also flags React 19-specific API changes.
howto.when_en: Triggers on tasks involving boolean prop proliferation refactors, component library builds, reusable API design, or compound components, render props, context providers, and component architecture.
